title: 3Spine Lumbar Fusion Real World Evidence Study
brief_summary: This study is designed to collect real world evidence (RWE) safety and efficacy data on patients who plan to undergo a single-level Transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion (TLIF) or Posterior lumbar interbody fusion (PLIF) instrumented with pedicle screws, using the framework of a prospective clinical study (with defined enrollment criteria and pre-specified research follow-up timepoints).
study_population: Subjects participating in this study will be recruited from the investigators' standard patient populations. Only patients who plan to undergo an Open or Mini-Open TLIF or PLIF procedure independent of this research protocol, are considered for study.
